senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Seth, son of Adam.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:12">Num. R. s. 14<sup>12</sup></cite> he called him <he>שת שממנו הושתת העולם</he> Seth (foundation), because with him the world’s foundation was laid.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:9:3">Cant. R. to VIII, 9</cite>; a. e.
